version.changelog: v2.1.0 新增可执行CLI工具(scripts/dev-tk.js+bin/dev-tk)：预提交检查/格式化/依赖分析/技术债务管理/脚手架(node/python/vue)

llm.summary: This is a disclosed developer CLI that runs local project checks and formatting commands when invoked by the user.

dimensions.detail: The shell execution, formatting, dependency checks, scaffold generation, and local file writes fit the stated developer-toolkit purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The documentation advertises more subcommands than the bundled CLI currently implements, but the implemented commands are user-directed and not hidden.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a markdown skill file plus a small bin wrapper that launches the bundled Node.js script; no unusual install-time execution is shown.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Commands such as npm test, pytest, go test, npx prettier, npx eslint, and npm outdated can execute or contact tooling in the target project, which is expected for this kind of developer utility.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to requested outputs such as scaffolded project files and .ads/tech-debt entries; no background worker, credential store access, or automatic persistence is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a developer helper that can run tests, format the current project, inspect git diffs, and create local project files when you invoke its commands. Review changes before committing, especially after formatting or scaffold operations.
llm.findings:
[suspicious.dangerous_exec] expected: The static scan flagged child_process.execSync, but the artifact uses it for fixed, local development commands consistent with the CLI purpose.
[SkillSpector:clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, which is consistent with the artifact review.
[VirusTotal:clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and does not conflict with the artifact evidence.
